q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of textile auxiliary chemicals per kg?
title: Textile auxiliaries carbon per kg
short: Add each raw material, such as surfactants, polymers or solvents, from supplier data. Then add the blending plant energy, electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and gas at its default factor, divided by kilograms produced.
audience: Makers of softeners, wetting agents, binders and other textile auxiliaries

ul: Heating for melting, emulsifying or reacting.

p: Brands and mills ask for a per-kilogram figure with its method. Give the plant energy per kilogram and list each raw material factor with its source, so the mill can see what is measured and what comes from a database.
If the plant makes many products, allocate energy by mass of output, or by batch hours if some products need long heating, and state the rule.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per kg (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Add raw materials (surfactants, polymers, solvents) from supplier data as their own lines
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; the plant energy is only the making stage, so raw materials must be added.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
